nodes.description: Public mapping(address=>uint) balanceOf holding token balances; written with raw arithmetic in transferFrom and list().
Public nested mapping allowance[owner][spender]; pre-approved to uniRouter and msg.sender->uniPair in constructor.
Fixed total supply 140736000000000000000000000, used to compute the owner share in list().
Hardcoded Uniswap V2 router address used as the external call target in list().
Hardcoded Uniswap V2 factory address used to derive the pair address.
Hardcoded WETH address used as a pairFor() input.
Private owner address set to msg.sender in the constructor; central access-control gate for delegate() and list().
Public derived Uniswap pair address, referenced by the checkLimits modifier.
Constant token decimals = 18.
Token name 'Yield Protocol'.
Token symbol 'YIELD'.
Private balance mapping of the abstract ERC20 base contract.
Private nested allowance mapping of the abstract ERC20 base contract.
Private total supply of the abstract ERC20 base contract.
Constructor that sets owner, derives uniPair and grants unlimited allowances to the router and to msg.sender over the pair.
Public payable transfer that simply delegates to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Public payable transferFrom guarded by the checkLimits modifier; performs allowance and balance updates with unchecked arithmetic.
Public payable approve that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] without zero-allowance mitigation.
Owner-only function executing delegatecall on an arbitrary address with arbitrary calldata.
Modifier restricting transfers: from/to must be owner, uniPair, or the caller must be owner, or tx.origin must be owner.
Internal pure helper computing the CREATE2 Uniswap V2 pair address from factory, WETH and this token.
Owner-only function that rewrites balances of address(this), msg.sender and arbitrary recipients and calls addLiquidityETH with a timestamp deadline.
Abstract ERC20 transfer forwarding to _transfer(msg.sender, recipient, amount).
Abstract ERC20 transferFrom performing _transfer and allowance decrement through SafeMath.sub.
Abstract ERC20 approve forwarding to _approve(msg.sender, spender, amount).
Internal ERC20 balance movement using SafeMath add/sub with zero-address checks.
Internal ERC20 mint increasing _totalSupply and recipient balance via SafeMath.
Internal ERC20 burn decreasing sender balance and _totalSupply via SafeMath.
Internal ERC20 allowance writer with zero-address checks.
Abstract ERC20 helper increasing caller's allowance via SafeMath.add.
Abstract ERC20 helper decreasing caller's allowance via SafeMath.sub.
View returning _totalSupply of the abstract ERC20 contract.
View returning _balances[account] of the abstract ERC20 contract.
View returning _allowances[owner][spender] of the abstract ERC20 contract.
Checked addition with overflow require.
Checked subtraction with underflow require.
Checked multiplication with overflow require.
Checked division with divide-by-zero require.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, allowance spender identity and transfer source.
tx.origin: transaction origin used inside checkLimits as an alternative authorization to owner.
block.timestamp: used in list() to build the Uniswap deadline, making execution time miner/validator influenceable.
Low-level delegatecall in delegate(a, b) executing arbitrary code from an owner-supplied address in the token's storage context.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value executed with unchecked arithmetic under Solidity 0.7.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value executed with unchecked arithmetic under Solidity 0.7.
balanceOf[_to] += _value executed with unchecked arithmetic under Solidity 0.7.
totalSupply * 6 / 100 multiplier used in list() without SafeMath, trivially safe only because operands are constants, but representative of unchecked math.
External payable call to the Uniswap router addLiquidityETH from list(), forwarding msg.value and address(this).

edges.reason: Constructor assigns msg.sender to the owner state variable, granting the deployer unrestricted control.
Constructor is the only place that initialises the owner access-control root.
Constructor calls pairFor to derive the Uniswap pair address.
Derived pair address is stored into uniPair.
Constructor grants unlimited allowance to uniRouter and to msg.sender over uniPair.
transfer delegates all work to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
msg.sender is used as the implicit source of the delegated transfer.
transfer amount parameter is forwarded into transferFrom.
transfer destination parameter controls where tokens are sent.
_from parameter drives allowance and balance lookups.
_to parameter drives the balance credit.
_value parameter drives all balance and allowance arithmetic.
msg.sender is compared with _from to decide whether the allowance branch and its authorisation are required.
transferFrom execution is gated by the checkLimits modifier.
checkLimits authorises the transfer when tx.origin == owner, allowing phishing/relay authorisation bypasses.
owner is compared inside checkLimits as a privileged sender/recipient.
uniPair is whitelisted inside checkLimits, allowing unrestricted pair transfers.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] is read and decremented during the transfer.
balanceOf entries are read and rewritten during the transfer.
transferFrom performs allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value without SafeMath.
_value is subtracted from the spender allowance unchecked.
transferFrom performs balanceOf[_from] -= _value without SafeMath.
_value is subtracted from the sender balance unchecked.
transferFrom performs balanceOf[_to] += _value without SafeMath.
_value is added to the recipient balance unchecked.
approve writes the allowance under msg.sender as owner key.
approve stores the new allowance value in the allowance mapping.
_spender parameter becomes the allowance key.
_value parameter becomes the newly granted allowance.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before executing.
owner value is the sole authorisation source for delegate.
delegate executes a delegatecall to an owner-supplied address with arbitrary data.
Parameter a is the delegatecall target and can be any contract.
Parameter b is executed as arbitrary calldata inside the token's storage context.
factory parameter feeds the pairFor CREATE2 hash.
tokenA parameter is sorted and hashed to derive the pair.
tokenB parameter is sorted and hashed to derive the pair.
list() requires msg.sender == owner before rewriting balances.
owner is the authorisation reference and the beneficiary of the list() balance rewrite.
_numList amount is used to overwrite balanceOf[address(this)] and as the liquidity amount.
_tos array drives the arbitrary balance-overwrite loop.
_amounts array provides the minted amounts written to each recipient.
Local loop index i iterates over _tos and _amounts while minting balances.
list() directly overwrites balanceOf for address(this), msg.sender and every recipient without any supply accounting.
Recipient addresses from _tos become balanceOf keys.
Amounts from _amounts become balanceOf values, arbitrarily minting tokens.
totalSupply is the operand of the unchecked share computation.
list() computes totalSupply * 6 / 100 outside SafeMath.
block.timestamp + 600 supplies the Uniswap deadline, making execution dependent on miner-controllable time.
list() performs an external payable call to the Uniswap router.
uniRouter is the external call target for addLiquidityETH.
The router call can re-enter transfer/transferFrom before list() finishes its post-call balance writes, allowing inconsistent balance state.
transfer() routes into transferFrom and is reachable during the external router callback.
Abstract ERC20 transfer uses msg.sender as the source of funds.
ERC20.transfer calls _transfer(msg.sender, recipient, amount).
ERC20.transferFrom performs the balance movement via _transfer.
ERC20.transferFrom reduces the spender allowance via _approve.
ERC20.approve forwards to _approve(msg.sender, spender, amount).
_transfer reads and writes the private _balances mapping.
_mint increments the recipient entry of _balances.
_mint increases _totalSupply.
_burn decrements the account entry of _balances.
_burn decreases _totalSupply.
_approve writes into the private _allowances mapping.
increaseAllowance writes the increased value through _approve.
decreaseAllowance writes the decreased value through _approve.
totalSupply view reads _totalSupply.
balanceOf view reads _balances.
allowance view reads _allowances.
_transfer uses SafeMath.add for the recipient credit.
_transfer uses SafeMath.sub for the sender debit.
_mint uses SafeMath.add for supply and balance increases.
_burn uses SafeMath.sub for balance and supply decreases.
increaseAllowance uses SafeMath.add.
decreaseAllowance uses SafeMath.sub.
ERC20.transferFrom uses SafeMath.sub on the spender allowance.

normalization_plan.reason: Destination parameter of transfer, meaningful only inside the transfer function node.
Amount parameter of transfer, no independent security semantic.
Source parameter drives transferFrom allowance and balance updates.
Destination parameter of transferFrom feeds the balance credit.
Amount parameter of transferFrom feeds all unchecked arithmetic sites.
Spender parameter is only the allowance mapping key in approve.
Amount parameter of approve written to the allowance mapping.
Target address parameter is consumed directly by the delegatecall unsafe operation.
Calldata parameter is executed by the delegatecall unsafe operation.
Factory parameter is only an input to the pairFor address derivation.
Token parameter is only an input to the pairFor address derivation.
Token parameter is only an input to the pairFor address derivation.
Liquidity amount parameter is consumed only inside list().
Recipient array parameter is consumed only by the list() overwrite loop.
Amount array parameter is consumed only by the list() overwrite loop.
Modifier source parameter is only evaluated inside the checkLimits gate.
Modifier destination parameter is only evaluated inside the checkLimits gate.
Loop index local is confined to the list() iteration and carries no standalone effect.
